title: Rick & Morty: The First Programming Language? Wubba Lubba Dub Dub!
caption: Who created the first programming language? 🤔 #HistoryOfComputing

scenes.script: Alright, Morty. Today we're diving into the ancient history of programming. The first one was Ada Lovelace in the 1840s.
Ada Lovelace? Like, the math lady? But she didn't have a computer!
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Exactly! She wrote the first algorithm for Charles Babbage’s Analytical Engine. It was like a recipe, Morty. A recipe for math!
So she was the OG programmer? Cool! But who made the first real programming language?
That would be Konrad Zuse in the 1940s with Plankalkul. It could store codes and automate tasks—like a robot butler, Morty!
Wait, so computers were already doing chores back then? Weird.
Then came Assembly Language in 1949, which simplified computer instructions. Think of it like a cheat sheet for computers.
Ahh, so instead of typing '010110', you could say 'add 2+3'? Neat!
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty with a dumb looking without understanding.png

scenes.script: Exactly! Then came Autocode in 1952, the first language that could be translated into machine code. Like a translator for computers!
So it’s like if you told me to do something in English, and I understood it without needing a dictionary?
Right! And these early languages paved the way for Fortran, ALGOL, and LISP. Like training wheels before a real bike!
scenes.web_image: Child learning to ride a bike with training wheels

scenes.script: And now we have Python, JavaScript, and all that jazz? Crazy how it all started with some math lady and her robot butler idea!
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty evil with a serious looking and a portal gun.png

scenes.script: Yep, and today we honor Ada Lovelace’s legacy with the ADA language. Now get back to learning, Morty!
Uh, Rick? Can you just give me the answer already?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty super angry biting his lips and frowning.png
